case_number: 2024 INSC 759; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 1031 OF 2015, CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 1578 OF 2017, CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 765 OF 2017, CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 1579 OF 2017
summary: Murder and abduction case arising from property dispute; deceased Neelam abducted from father's house; appellants' conviction by High Court after Trial Court acquittal; High Court reappreciation of evidence; motive linked to property litigation over Jang Bahadur Singh's estate; Trial Court acquitted Accused 6-7 due to lack of evidence; High Court reversed acquittal based on exclusion of PW5, consistency of PW2/PW4/PW18; Supreme Court considered whether reappreciation valid, motive established for Accused 6-7, sufficiency of evidence; detailed examination of witness testimonies, circumstantial evidence; Section 34 IPC common intention applied; final determination on guilt standard.
final_judgment: To be determined based on Supreme Court's evaluation of High Court's reappreciation of evidence, adequacy of motive, and sufficiency of proof against Accused 6-7.
